text:
Anya: Quick post-AH follow-up — compiling the open asks, decisions, and owners from today's Q&A. TL;DR: decision cards created, owners set, a few parking-lot items. Links and next steps below. :sparkles:

Sam: awesome, can you paste the decision cards link?

Anya: yep — decision cards -> https://internal.redwood.dev/ah/decision-cards. Key confirmed decisions:
- Dedicated GA target: 2023-10-18 (owner: @Kevin)
- Runtime freeze milestone: 2023-10-02 (owner: @Kevin)
- Private deployment checklist: owner @Maria
- Console retention plan (short term): owner @Sam

Kevin: confirming Dedicated GA 2023-10-18. Engineering milestone (runtime freeze) is 2023-10-02 — I'll post the freeze plan by end of day Monday.

Maria: I claimed the private deploy checklist. I'll add preflight items and a validation plan by EOD Friday. Need an infra review slot to validate networking/KMS assumptions.

Sam: console retention — I'll scope storage cost, retention tiers, and sketch the UI changes. Draft here: https://internal.redwood.dev/notes/console-retention (will update today).

Product-Bot: NOTE: owners and due-dates added to the decision-cards doc (kanban lane: "backlog -> in progress").

Anya: Short action list (owners + due dates):
1) @Kevin — finalize runtime freeze plan and compatibility matrix (due 2023-10-02)
2) @Maria — preflight checklist + book infra review (due 2023-09-29)
3) @Sam — retention cost estimate + UX sketch (due 2023-09-30)
4) @Anya (product) — draft customer comms for Dedicated GA (due 2023-10-05)

Sam: small ask from ops/stakeholders — can we include a short fallback blurb describing behavior when Dedicated capacity is exhausted? customers want clarity.

Anya: yes — will draft the fallback blurb and post to #product by Wed.

Kevin: flagging a perf risk we discussed: some customers hit sequence lengths >8k. Proposal: add a routing knob to route high-seq traffic to high-memory nodes (or fall back to hosted slower path). Will outline options in the runtime freeze doc.

Maria: noted — adding a test case to the private deploy checklist to validate long-sequence workloads and memory/latency characteristics.

OpsBot: Reminder: infra review slots available next Tue 10:00 & Thu 15:00 — please book in #eng-infra.

Anya: Parking-lot items (not blocking GA):
- Evals dashboard UX refinements
- Optimize suggestions for common prompt patterns (Reduce cost)
- Long-term quantization policy and release plan

Sam: can someone produce a one-pager for exec/stakeholders on cost vs latency tradeoffs (small table + recommended knobs)? That would help the comms thread.

Anya: will draft a one-pager and attach it to the decision-cards doc by Monday.

Kevin: tagging owners — @Maria @Sam @Anya — propose a quick sync Mon 11:00 to confirm owners, signoffs, and infra slots.

Maria: Mon 11:00 works for me.

Anya: Thanks all — if you see missing owners or need to reassign, reply here. Will keep this thread as the single canonical follow-up for AH Q&A. :white_check_mark:
